_doc: Bot cycle 57.4 (M3): scripted stress scenarios on the canonical list (paired: unperturbed vs perturbed on identical shuffles). Built by scripts/grixis_stress.py; schema test.schema.json. Not win rates.

records.mulligan: keep 2-5 lands with (lands + mana sources costing <= 2) >= 3; otherwise mulligan; always keep at 5 cards or fewer; bottom (London): excess lands beyond 4 first, then the highest mana value nonlands
records.seat: multiplayer, seat-agnostic (no turn-1 draw skip, CR 103.8c); first mulligan free (CR 103.5c)
records.scenario: commander_removed_once@T4: the commander is removed (to the command zone) at the end of the first turn >= T it is on the battlefield

scenario_metrics.method: share of perturbed games in which the scripted event happened (e.g. the commander was on the battlefield to be removed)
share of games with a commander removal in which the commander was recast by turn 10
turns from the first removal (end step) to the recast, among games where it was recast
share of removal games where the commander was recast within 2 turns

limitations: Goldfish stress test: one player, scripted perturbations, no opponents; never a win rate.

Model 1.1 adds: draw on resolution / enters triggers (incl. wheels and loot discards), upkeep/draw-step draw triggers, suspend timing, tutors (spell or enters trigger; to hand, top or battlefield; target = missing piece of the closest combo, else a blueprint tutor target, else an identity-core card, else the highest-MV legal card; no re-shuffle, which is distributionally identical), rituals (cast only when they enable an otherwise uncastable card), one-shot mana (sacrifice sources, doesn't-untap rocks, Jeweled Lotus for the commander only, spent only when needed), treasures from resolution / enters effects, and the conditions of Chrome Mox, Mox Amber, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Paradise Mantle, Springleaf Drum (imprint / land discard / metalcraft / a legend's colours / an untapped non-mana creature).

Model 1.1 still leaves out: opponent-dependent draw (Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora), activated or repeating draw and tutors (Sensei's Divining Top, Tamiyo's Journal, Wishclaw Talisman), attack/cast/death triggers, Lion's Eye Diamond, sacrifice additional costs (Deadly Dispute, Culling the Weak: not paid; 'discard a card' additional costs are paid), X costs, Paradise Mantle's equip cost, graveyard tutors (Entomb, Buried Alive) and recursion, discard to hand size.

The graveyard holds only what the model puts there (cast instants/sorceries, countered, destroyed, discarded or wheeled-away cards, Mox Diamond lands); self-mill and recursion are not modelled, so graveyard_exiled mostly measures nothing in this model.
A graveyard piece counts toward a combo only when some piece of that combo mentions a graveyard in its Oracle text (recursion assumed, not simulated).
